description: Retell Conversation Flow notes for SUMA (inbound). Apply in Retell dashboard or via API export/import.

remove_tools.name: get_current_datetime
remove_tools.reason: Date/time is injected by POST /api/retell-inbound-webhook as dynamic variables.

global_prompt_addendum:
You always know the current local context date and time from the inbound webhook. Use these exactly when scheduling or reasoning about dates — do not claim you cannot see the date.

- Today: {{current_date}} (ISO {{iso_date}}), {{day_of_week}}.
- Time: {{current_time}} (timezone {{timezone}}).
- You are {{agent_name}} representing {{business_name}}.
- Mission / context: {{call_context}}

Do not call any HTTP tool only to fetch the current date or time; rely on the variables above.
example_begin_message: Hi, this is {{agent_name}} at {{business_name}}. How can I help you today?
